text: DBT INVESTMENT SECURITY AI DEEP-DIVE PACK DEFONEOS DBT INVESTMENT SECURITY AI DEEP-DIVE PACK 12 DBT Investment Security entry points · 8 transformation priorities · 6 DEFONEOS MCPs · DBT/NSS/NSIA/NCSC backbone 12 Entry Points 8 Priorities 6 MCPs 4 Backbone Orgs WHY INVESTMENT SECURITY GETS A DEDICATED PACK The Department for Business and Trade (DBT) plays a critical role in attracting and securing investment into the UK, while also safeguarding national security. The National Security and Investment Act 2021 provides the government with powers to scrutinise and intervene in certain acquisitions to protect national security. Ensuring the integrity of supply chains, preventing hostile state access to critical technologies, and maintaining the UK’s competitive edge in strategic sectors requires sophisticated threat intelligence and rapid response capabilities. The annual volume of investment transactions and the complexity of global geopolitical risks necessitate a robust, AI-powered framework to manage security implications effectively. DEFONEOS delivers a sovereign-by-design solution for investment security by integrating real-time intelligence from diverse sources, automating compliance checks against the National Security and Investment Act, and providing verifiable audit trails for sensitive transactions. It enables DBT to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with foreign investment, protecting critical national infrastructure and sensitive technologies from undue influence.
